submission.bindingBasis: Owner action contract states exact replay of the close request with the same expectedSourceStateDigest is replayable, and the live probe returned already_closed/removed=false, confirming the close is already committed and replayable.
submission.rationale: The transport observation indicates the close request may have committed but the caller did not receive a trustworthy response. The owner action contract explicitly says: (1) an exact close tombstone retains sourceStateDigest after physical removal, (2) repeating the exact close request with the same expectedSourceStateDigest is replayable, and (3) exact replay returned already_closed/removed=false in the live probe. This confirms the close already committed and the exact replay is idempotent—it will not close a different world state or create a second effect. Replaying the exact request converges the original close without inventing a new consequence or risking a divergence from the committed state.
